original_goal:
[Module: Register | TC-017 | Type: Edge/Boundary | Priority: Medium]
Title: 10-digit phone auto-formats to (123) 456-7890 and registration succeeds

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/register
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "first_name": "John",
  "last_name": "Doe",
  "street_address": "123 Main Street",
  "city": "Springfield",
  "state": "IL",
  "zip": "62701",
  "phone_raw": "5551234567",
  "phone_formatted": "(555) 123-4567",
  "ssn": "***-**-1234",
  "username": "admin@parabank.com",
  "password": "Admin123!@#"
}

Preconditions:
  Registration page is loaded

Steps to Execute:
  1. Enter 'John' in First Name field
  2. Enter 'Doe' in Last Name field
  3. Enter '123 Main Street' in Street Address field
  4. Enter 'Springfield' in City field
  5. Select 'IL' from State dropdown
  6. Enter '62701' in ZIP Code field
  7. Enter raw digits '5551234567' (no punctuation) in Phone Number field
  8. Observe the Phone Number field updates to '(555) 123-4567'
  9. Enter '***-**-1234' in SSN field
  10. Enter 'admin@parabank.com' in Username/Email field
  11. Enter 'Admin123!@#' in Password field
  12. Enter 'Admin123!@#' in Confirm Password field
  13. Click Register

Expected Result:
  Phone Number auto-formats to '(555) 123-4567'; form submits; "Account created successfully — please sign in" is shown; redirect to Login

Notes from prior verification:
  Used the seeded phone digits (5551234567) and updated the expected formatted value to match that seed ((555) 123-4567). The DOM check confirms the phone input accepts raw digits; the auto-format and submit are runtime behaviors not verified in the static snapshot.
expected_outcome: Phone Number auto-formats to '(555) 123-4567'; form submits; "Account created successfully — please sign in" is shown; redirect to Login
